props.custom_logic_resolution:
const TAG = "[CL-RES][ON-HIT-GRAPPLED-IF-FRESH-TURN]";

const p = __PAYLOAD ?? {};

const args = globalThis.__ARGS ?? p.__confirmArgs ?? {};

const GRAPPLED_AE_UUID = "Item.XVOWOq9oUmEECGrU.ActiveEffect.QM91tXm46BFaTR9W";

p.meta = p.meta || {};

const targetUuids =

Array.isArray(p?.originalTargetUUIDs) && p.originalTargetUUIDs.length

? [...p.originalTargetUUIDs]

: Array.isArray(p?.meta?.originalTargetUUIDs) && p.meta.originalTargetUUIDs.length

? [...p.meta.originalTargetUUIDs]

: Array.isArray(p?.targets) && p.targets.length

? [...p.targets]

: Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS) && globalThis.__TARGETS.length

? [...globalThis.__TARGETS]

: [];

if (!targetUuids.length) {

console.log(TAG, "No targets found. Skipping.");

return;

}

const combat = game.combat ?? null;

if (!combat) {

console.log(TAG, "No active combat. Skipping.");

return;

}

const accTotal = Number(p?.accuracy?.total ?? args?.accuracyTotal ?? NaN);

const hasAccuracy =

(typeof args?.hasAccuracy === "boolean")

? args.hasAccuracy

: !!p?.accuracy;

const autoHit = !!(

args?.autoHit ||

p?.advPayload?.autoHit ||

p?.accuracy?.isCrit

);

const getDef = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const row = p?.meta?.defenseSnapshot?.perTarget?.find?.(r => r?.uuid === targetUuid) ?? null;

return Number(

row?.def ??

row?.defense ??

row?.physicalDefense ??

targetActor?.system?.props?.defense ??

0

) || 0;

};

const isHit = (targetUuid, targetActor) => {

const def = getDef(targetUuid, targetActor);

if (!hasAccuracy) return true;

if (autoHit) return true;

if (!Number.isFinite(accTotal)) return false;

return accTotal >= def;

};

const getTokenId = (doc) =>

doc?.token?.id ??

doc?.id ??

doc?.document?.id ??

null;

const getSceneId = (doc) =>

doc?.parent?.id ??

doc?.document?.parent?.id ??

null;

const getCombatantForDoc = (docLike, actorLike) => {

const ref = docLike?.document ?? docLike;

const tokenId = getTokenId(ref);

const sceneId = getSceneId(ref);

const actorId = actorLike?.id ?? ref?.actor?.id ?? ref?.id ?? null;

let c = combat.combatants.find(cmb => {

const cSceneId = cmb.sceneId ?? cmb.parent?.scene?.id ?? cmb.scene?.id ?? null;

const cTokenId = cmb.tokenId ?? cmb.token?.id ?? null;

return tokenId && cTokenId === tokenId && (!sceneId || !cSceneId || cSceneId === sceneId);

});

if (c) return c;

c = combat.combatants.find(cmb => (cmb.actor?.id ?? null) === actorId);

if (c) return c;

return null;

};

const hasNotTakenTurnYet = (combatant) => {

if (!combatant) return false;

const currentActs = Number(

combatant.getFlag?.("lancer-initiative", "activations.value") ??

combatant.flags?.["lancer-initiative"]?.activations?.value ??

NaN

);

const maxActs = Number(

combatant.getFlag?.("lancer-initiative", "activations.max") ??

combatant.flags?.["lancer-initiative"]?.activations?.max ??

NaN

);

if (Number.isFinite(currentActs) && Number.isFinite(maxActs)) {

return maxActs > 0 && currentActs === maxActs;

}

if (Number.isFinite(currentActs)) {

return currentActs > 0;

}

return false;

};

const grappledSource = await fromUuid(GRAPPLED_AE_UUID);

if (!grappledSource) {

console.warn(TAG, "Could not resolve Grappled AE source UUID.", GRAPPLED_AE_UUID);

return;

}

const grappledData = grappledSource.toObject();

delete grappledData._id;

grappledData.origin = GRAPPLED_AE_UUID;

grappledData.transfer = false;

const applied = [];

const checked = [];

for (const tuuid of targetUuids) {

const td = await fromUuid(tuuid);

const targetDoc = td?.document ?? td;

const targetActor = td?.actor ?? td;

if (!targetActor) {

checked.push({ targetUuid: tuuid, skipped: "missing-target-actor" });

continue;

}

const targetCombatant = getCombatantForDoc(targetDoc, targetActor);

const def = getDef(tuuid, targetActor);

const hit = isHit(tuuid, targetActor);

const freshTurn = hasNotTakenTurnYet(targetCombatant);

checked.push({

target: targetActor?.name ?? tuuid,

hit,

accTotal,

def,

freshTurn,

combatantId: targetCombatant?.id ?? null

});

if (!hit) continue;

if (!freshTurn) continue;

const existing = targetActor.effects?.find(e =>

e?.origin === GRAPPLED_AE_UUID ||

(grappledData?.name && e?.name === grappledData.name)

);

if (existing) {

await existing.delete().catch(() => {});

}

const [created] = await targetActor.createEmbeddedDocuments("ActiveEffect", [grappledData]);

applied.push({

target: targetActor?.name ?? tuuid,

effectId: created?.id ?? null

});

}

p.meta.onHitGrappledFreshTurn = {

applied,

checked,

accuracyTotal: accTotal,

hasAccuracy,

autoHit

};

console.log(TAG, "DONE", {

accuracyTotal: accTotal,

hasAccuracy,

autoHit,

applied,

checked

});
